obligations.source_text: Create an adult Mughal screened-courtyard private household reconstruction whose screened architecture, connected adult activity, portable objects, and prepared result are all testable in one photograph.

bindings.mughal_private_entry_phrase: an offset or bent private entrance blocks a direct public sight line into the residence before the camera reaches the screened inner courtyard
bindings.mughal_courtyard_room_phrase: a central courtyard with jali or equivalent screening connects arcades and multiple small rooms across a single clearly readable depth axis
bindings.mughal_adult_activity_phrase: multiple adults perform distinct textile music game or organizing actions around the same courtyard as one connected household preparation chain
bindings.mughal_activity_object_phrase: portable textiles low seating instruments boards or baskets connect the adults to one household activity through visible carrying, tuning, arranging, and checking actions
bindings.mughal_activity_result_phrase: arranged textiles occupied seating or placed activity objects show the immediate prepared result through emptied baskets and a ready tuned instrument
